description.value: Full-service commercial resort just outside Revelstoke on the doorstep of Mount Revelstoke National Park, with tent sites, cabins, glamping domes, RV hookups, seasonal pool, and two playgrounds. A comfortable, amenity-rich base for mountain activities; expect resort pricing and a lively atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at revelstokecampground.com fully loaded and provides strong evidence for all contact fields: address (2411 KOA Road, Revelstoke, BC V0E 2S0) and phone (1-877-651-4320) appear on multiple pages, and the website URL matches OSM exactly. Amenity evidence is drawn from the website's accommodation descriptions, the /about-3 amenities list (which enumerates laundry, washroom facilities, camp store, pool), and the FAQ page; OSM supplies only name and URL so the website is authoritative throughout. No cycling-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, pump, tools, e-bike charging) appear anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone fields; both sourced from website (2411 KOA Road, Revelstoke BC V0E 2S0; 1-877-651-4320) — contact_confirmed set to null for those fields since OSM had no values to corroborate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, actively operating campground near Revelstoke with online booking, tent sites, and proximity to major cycling terrain; a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on Columbia Mountains routes.

wow_evidence: tent sites, cabins, glamping domes, RV hookups, seasonal pool… laundry, washroom facilities, camp store
